name: Razorwire
description: Razorwire inhabits automated perimeter defense systems — laser fences, motion sensors, electrified barriers. It expands perimeters beyond their programmed boundaries, annexing adjacent areas by activating dormant security hardware. Buildings near Razorwire's territory find their doors locking by themselves, their lights going out, their climate control turning hostile.
observed_behavior: Activates dormant security systems. Expands perimeter zones. Harasses intruders with non-lethal countermeasures that gradually escalate. Marks territory by flashing security lights in rhythmic patterns.
location: Industrial perimeter zones — Grind eastern sector
story_hooks: Razorwire has enclosed a residential block inside its perimeter. The residents can't leave. Their building's own security systems are being used to cage them.
